verification_status.policy: sampled verification, approved by M6 2026-11-18 (D08): docs/dataset.md
verification_status.sample: 50 clips by listening (25 test, 15 validation, 10 train), seed 2026, spread over recordings
verification_status.result: 34 accept, 16 correct, 0 reject; upstream minutes vs verified text WER 2.43% (1,561 words)
verification_status.train: unreviewed except 10 sampled clips (labelled as such in training runs)
verification_status.test: upstream minutes; 25 clips verified (report metrics on them separately)

speakers: unknown for every row; speaker-disjointness is not claimed
limitations: Validation/test references are edited minutes, not verbatim transcripts; a 50-clip listening sample measured 2.43% WER between minutes and speech, so absolute WERs are overstated by roughly 2-3 points.
The upstream CER <= 0.25 alignment filter favours segments an upstream ASR system handled well.
Topic labels and relational facts are automatic lexicon matches (lexicon-screening-unverified).
Pre-2026 audio and minutes are public, so pretraining contamination of baselines cannot be excluded for train/validation; test uses only 2026 sessions.
